video_title: Boogie - Draymond Green Foul on Wemby WASN’T DIRTY

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Panel debates if Draymond Green's foul on Victor Wembanyama was dirty
quotes.excerpt: There's nothing else to call this but dirty, right Chandler? We're not pretending it's not.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: There's nothing else to call this but dirty, right Chandler? We're not pretending it's not.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Yeah, this isn't cool. This is dirty. This isn't a hard foul, this isn't effort, this isn't him making a statement. This is a guy who doesn't even see him coming and you put him on the floor.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: It is definitely a dangerous play, but I don't think his intentions were in the wrong place. I'm thinking from a big man standpoint as far as trying to block out a 7-foot-5 guy at the rim.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: You act like bigs don't get pushed in the back all the time on rebounds.

quotes.social_post: Michelle Beadle and the panel debate the Draymond Green foul on Victor Wembanyama. Beadle calls it a dangerous play, while DeMarcus Cousins argues it was just a big man trying to box out a 7 foot 5 guy at the rim.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons and DeMarcus Cousins argue about the nature of the foul
quotes.excerpt: He's 90 feet and pushed him from behind, but that's not a damn box out.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: You're shoving him from 90 feet and pushed him from behind, but that's not a damn box out.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: So as a big, you create contact on the box out. I don't see the problem. Obviously, it could have been a dangerous play, but I don't think his intentions were to hurt the guy.

quotes.social_post: Chandler Parsons pushes back on the idea that Draymond Green was making a legitimate box out on his foul against Wembanyama, saying you do not shove a player from behind like that.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Debate over whether Draymond Green was making a play for the ball
quotes.excerpt: At what point do you make a play for the ball?

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: At what point do you make a play for the ball?

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: He was making a play for the ball. He tried to go for a box out. He tried to create contact.

quotes.social_post: Chandler Parsons argues that Draymond Green was attempting to make a play for the ball and create contact during the sequence with Victor Wembanyama.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons evaluates the Utah Jazz roster and future outlook
quotes.excerpt: They have talent, they're missing their two of their best players, Jaren Jackson and Lauri Markkanen.
quotes.quote: They have talent, they're missing their two of their best players, Jaren Jackson and Lauri Markkanen, and that's obviously going to hurt. They have Walker Kessler, they have Ace Bailey, but they're still ways away. This is one of the teams I'm not surprised because they lost those two guys, but I thought maybe they could mess around and get in the play-in, be competitive. They have so much talent where I don't think this is like a panic rebuild. They're already in the rebuild. Now they've acquired these young assets, they have young talent. Markkanen is always going to be a hot name who teams are always going to be interested in. Maybe you see what you can get for him. Same with Jaren Jackson. I thought they should have resigned Walker Kessler, but that also didn't match their timeline of what they're doing right now.
quotes.social_post: Chandler Parsons discusses the Jazz rebuild, noting that Lauri Markkanen remains a hot name on the trade market and the team is still ways away from being competitive.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins remains optimistic about the Jazz's young core
quotes.excerpt: This is a group of young guys that have to figure out how to win in this league.
quotes.quote: This is a group of young guys that have to figure out how to win in this league, have to go through the experiences that everybody else has had to go through. Keyonte George being a second, third-year player, he's still young figuring it out. Obviously, Danny Ainge and his staff, they're going to make that happen. Obviously, Lauri Markkanen is a hot name on the market. I hope a team like the Warriors go out and get him to get some help for Steph. I think the Jazz are right where they're supposed to be. They're in the right place, I don't think they need to panic, just kind of continue to go through the motions, let your young guys learn this league and they have a really bright future.
quotes.social_post: DeMarcus Cousins says he hopes the Warriors go out and trade for Lauri Markkanen to get some help for Steph Curry, adding that the Jazz are in the right place with their young core.
